text: A tiny entry file that costs 461x the median per KB is a **dependency tree**, not a file. Measured (`probe-module-tree.php`): `cms/helpers.php` (1857 B) pulls **38 files / 1224 KB**; `ecommerce` (3.6 KB) pulls **47 files / 932 KB**. `cms` + `ecommerce` account for **43% of the whole measured registration load from 5.4 KB of entry files**.
